title: Store Credit Held on a Northbeam Credit Account: Terms by Product
content:
**Condition 12 — Store credit held on the account.** Store credit held on an account of the Northbeam Store Credit and Financing Accounts range is governed by six terms of the product held.

12.1 Store credit stays spendable for the validity days of the product, and is swept on the sweep basis the product states.

12.2 An amount of store credit smaller than the product's least single spend is not spent at once.

12.3 Store credit is spent ahead of the account itself, in the priority the product states.

12.4 Whether store credit may be moved to another profile, and whether it may be turned back into money, are terms of the product.

| Product | Days store credit stays spendable | Least amount spent at once | Moved to another profile | Spend priority | Turned back into money | When unspent store credit is swept |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northbeam Store Card | 365 | 1.00 | not allowed | store credit first, then the card | not allowed | at the end of the month the validity days run out in |
| Northbeam Store Card Plus | 365 | 1.00 | not allowed | store credit first, then the card | not allowed | at the end of the month the validity days run out in |
| Northbeam Signature Rewards Card | 730 | 1.00 | allowed | store credit first, then the card | not allowed | at the end of the month the validity days run out in |
| Northbeam Deferred Interest Promotion Account | 365 | 1.00 | not allowed | store credit first, then the card | not allowed | at the end of the month the validity days run out in |
| Northbeam Business Net Thirty Account | 365 | 25.00 | allowed | store credit first, then the invoice | not allowed | at the end of the quarter the validity days run out in |
| Northbeam Business Fleet Line of Credit | 365 | 25.00 | allowed | store credit first, then the invoice | not allowed | at the end of the quarter the validity days run out in |

Money figures are US dollars.

## How the two ends of a term read

On a product whose least single spend is 25.00, store credit of 25.00 may be spent at once and store credit of 24.99 may not. On a product whose figure is 1.00, an amount of 1.00 may be spent at once.

The validity days stand at 365 on five products in the range and at 730 on the Northbeam Signature Rewards Card, which is twice as long. Where the sweep basis is the end of the month the validity days run out in, credit whose validity days run out on any day of a month is swept at the end of that same month; where the basis is the end of the quarter, credit whose validity days run out on any day inside a quarter is swept at the end of that quarter.

No product in the range turns store credit back into money.
